.name: Batch query my Steam wishlist
.note: Look up each AppID on the current Steam wishlist and return the entry, region, current price, discount and available historical low. found=false means the game is not on the wishlist.
.description: Look up each AppID on the current Steam wishlist and return the entry, region, current price, discount and available historical low. found=false means the game is not on the wishlist.
.parameters.appIds: One or more valid Steam AppIDs (integers).
